name: Koenigsegg Jesko
h1: Koenigsegg Jesko: performance, engine and what owners say

gens.tag: Only 125 built, as Attack or Absolut. Twin-turbo V8 with 1,600 hp on E85.

variants.name: Jesko Attack

hp.note: on E85; 1,280 hp at 7,800 rpm on regular gasoline

tq.note: lb-ft at 5,100 rpm on E85 (1,500 Nm); 1,000 Nm (738 lb-ft) from 2,700 to 6,170 rpm on gasoline

trans.note: seven wet clutches; it can jump straight to any gear

weight.note: Koenigsegg curb weight, 1,420 kg; 1,320 kg dry

price.note: reported starting price, about $3 million; Koenigsegg publishes no US price

variants.what: High-downforce version with a big rear wing, up to 1,400 kg of downforce. Customer cars from late 2022.

variants.name: Jesko Absolut

hp.note: on E85; 1,280 hp at 7,800 rpm on regular gasoline

tq.note: lb-ft at 5,100 rpm on E85 (1,500 Nm); 1,000 Nm (738 lb-ft) from 2,700 to 6,170 rpm on gasoline

top.note: maker claim from simulation only, never tested; it reached 256 mph during its 2024 record run

trans.note: seven wet clutches; it can jump straight to any gear

weight.note: Koenigsegg curb weight, 1,390 kg; 1,290 kg dry

variants.what: Low-drag version built for top speed: no big wing, 0.278 Cd. It set a 0-249-0 mph record of 27.8 seconds in 2024.

koenigsegg-v8.name: Koenigsegg 5.0 twin-turbo V8 (Jesko)
facts: 1,280 hp at 7,800 rpm on gasoline, 1,600 hp on E85; 1,500 Nm (1,106 lb-ft) peak
180-degree flat-plane crank cut from one steel billet, Koenigsegg's first
Aluminum block, 92 x 95.25 mm, dry sump, 1.7 bar boost (2.2 bar on E85), 189 kg

issues.x: No recurring engine failure is documented for this V8, and only 125 cars are being built. The one known Jesko fire was traced to a hydraulic hose, not the engine.
A Jesko burned out in Greece in June 2024. Koenigsegg blamed a leaking pressurized hydraulic hose and asked owners to wait for a hose check before driving.
issues.fix: Service centers inspect the hoses, and Koenigsegg said it would add software that shuts the hydraulic system down when pressure drops.
